method: Visual review of original-frame contact sheets and original f194 after the first exploratory run. Asphalt gutters roadward of a raised kerb count as carriageway; raised kerbs and sidewalks count as roadside. Cutscenes and obscured supporting surfaces are excluded. This is an exploratory set, not a blinded held-out validation set. Scores use the current labels, including corrections that increase carriageway errors.
